aboutPage.eyebrow: A living archive and open toolchain
aboutPage.title: About Haneoka
aboutPage.description: Haneoka turns BanG Dream! Our Notes into a browser experience that moves from story scenes and searchable catalogues to community spaces, chart tools, and the craft of making and publishing.
aboutPage.experienceTitle: Read the world, then stay in it
aboutPage.experienceIntro: The browser is the first stage: a story player, a deep catalogue, and a social layer meet around the same material.

experience.title: Follow the story
experience.body: Open dialogue, choices, scene direction, animation, audio, and video in a browser story player, then carry the thread through history, saves, settings, and branching scenes.

experience.title: Explore every thread
experience.body: Search multilingual game data across characters, cards, songs, stories, events, and system collections, then move from detail pages into audio, comic, asset, Live2D, Spine, and chart experiences.

experience.title: Make it a shared place
experience.body: Accounts and community workspaces bring feeds, posts, comments, reactions, bookmarks, tags, notifications, profiles and attachments into the same archive.

aboutPage.ecosystemIntro: The experience grows through explicit contracts: hosts, renderers, runtimes, plugins, data releases, and interfaces each bring a focused capability to the stage.

ecosystem.title: Haneoka · the browser stage
ecosystem.body: Astro renders locale-aware document routes and a shared shell; Lit and TypeScript mount route-scoped workspaces, while Workers, D1, and R2 connect services, account and community data, and immutable catalogue releases and media.

ecosystem.title: Vega · choose the renderer
ecosystem.body: Vega keeps the renderer, character systems, themes, resources, and interface replaceable while its runtime carries dialogue, choices, scenes, animation, audio, video, saves, history, settings, and branching stories across web and native hosts.

ecosystem.title: Cassiopeia · rhythm by contract
ecosystem.body: The kernel owns integer timing, candidate selection, judgement, scoring, and session state. Typed plugins declare versions, dependencies, and services; audio hosts, Three.js rendering, Vue UI, and Sonolus play, watch, preview, and tutorial targets compose around it.

ecosystem.title: Typed extensions · room for new forms
ecosystem.body: Story projects carry plugin versions, extension fields and authored order; chart projects retain extension data and source metadata. Format adapters connect authoring workflows and carry editable projects into preview and release.

aboutPage.toolchainTitle: From reading to making to publishing
aboutPage.toolchainIntro: The surrounding tools carry an idea from a precise project model through authoring, localization, validation, and release targets.

toolchain.title: Schedar · shape the chart
toolchain.body: An editable chart model brings together tempo maps, beat snapping, viewport and waveform tools, validation, and mergeable undo/redo history. Import and export Schedar JSON, SS and USC, and import SUS with conversion diagnostics.

toolchain.title: Altair · author the scene
toolchain.body: Compose scenes, dialogue, assets, languages, and story flow in a visual workspace. YAML 1.2 project and scene documents pair with a canonical StoryProject model, plugin contributions, resource browsing, history, drafts, and Vega preview.

toolchain.title: Deneb · prepare the release
toolchain.body: Check project resources and plugins, resolve the build graph, make inputs reproducible, and create release projects for the web, offline-capable PWAs, Electron, Tauri, Android, and iOS.

aboutPage.repositoriesIntro: Each repository carries a distinct piece of the experience, from the browser archive to the engines and authoring tools behind it.

repositories.title: Haneoka
repositories.body: The catalogue, browser experience, interactive workspaces, community services, and deployment surface.

repositories.title: Vega
repositories.body: Visual-novel engine, renderer and plugin contracts, story runtime, and framework adapters.

repositories.title: Cassiopeia
repositories.body: Portable rhythm kernel with timing, judgement, scoring, session state, and typed plugin boundaries.

repositories.title: Cassiopeia Sonolus plugin
repositories.body: Chart conversion and plugin integration between Cassiopeia and Sonolus.

repositories.title: Sonolus Our Notes
repositories.body: Standalone play, watch, preview and tutorial targets with native gameplay presentation.

repositories.title: Altair
repositories.body: Visual authoring, localization, YAML project documents, plugin host, resource browser, and Vega preview.

repositories.title: Deneb
repositories.body: Project validation, plugin resolution, and release projects for web, PWA, desktop and mobile targets.

aboutPage.footerBody: Haneoka connects reference, performance and creation through an open collection of engines and tools. Each engine has its own interfaces and workflow; each plugin can become part of a new work.
aboutPage.heroTitle: Give every story a bigger stage

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.summary: This Privacy Policy describes how the maintainers of haneoka (the “Operator”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) collect, use, disclose, retain, and protect information when haneoka provides its public archive, community, account, and related services (collectively, the “Service”). Please read it before creating an account or submitting information.

sections.body:
The haneoka project maintainers operate the Service and act as the controller or responsible organization to the extent required by applicable law. This Policy applies to the haneoka website, account system, community, uploads, moderation, and support interactions. It does not govern third-party websites, applications, or services linked from the Service.

The homepage and public archive can be viewed without an account. Authentication is required only for account features, community participation, uploads, or saved server-side preferences. Merely viewing public pages may still produce ordinary network and security records described below.
sections.title: Operator, scope, and public access

sections.body:
We process the email address used for registration, sign-in, verification, password recovery, and security notices; profile information such as display name, handle, biography, and avatar; and community material such as posts, comments, attachments, tags, reactions, bookmarks, follows, blocks, mutes, recommendation feedback, reports, and appeals. We also process information included in support, rights, or abuse requests.

Passwords are transmitted only for account operations and are stored as one-way salted password hashes, not as plaintext passwords. Community edits and deletions create new revisions or state records rather than overwriting all prior records. Do not submit confidential information that is unnecessary for the relevant feature.
sections.title: Information you provide

sections.body:
Email registration creates a pending account and sends a time-limited link through which the mailbox holder chooses the final password. The email address is verified and a public numeric UID is assigned only after setup succeeds. Reissuing a setup email invalidates an earlier setup link after the new delivery request is accepted.

If you choose Google, GitHub, X, or Discord sign-in, we receive the identifiers and basic account information needed to authenticate you, which may include a verified email address and account name. OAuth tokens are encrypted by the application before database storage. Google user data is used only for sign-in, account security, and user-facing account functionality; it is not sold, used for advertising, or transferred to data brokers. You may revoke provider access through the relevant provider’s account settings, including Google’s connected-app controls at https://myaccount.google.com/connections.
sections.title: Email-only registration and third-party sign-in

sections.body:
For security, abuse prevention, moderation, and audit purposes, we record the original IP address supplied by Cloudflare and the full User-Agent associated with relevant account and community actions, together with timestamps, request identifiers, session and rate-limit data, and action metadata. The original IP address is stored in plaintext in the application database and is not application-level encrypted. It is available only through authorized administrative interfaces, subject to access controls.

Public content may show only the country or territory and first-level administrative region derived from Cloudflare request metadata, plus generalized browser and operating-system icons derived from the User-Agent. The Service does not use GPS to determine precise location. IP-based location can be inaccurate, particularly when a proxy, VPN, mobile network, or corporate gateway is used.

Cloudflare also processes operational logs and sampled request traces to diagnose errors, analyse performance and address security issues. The relevant service configuration determines their contents and retention.
sections.title: Network, IP-region, and device information

sections.body:
The service uses cookies for sign-in, session security and OAuth, plus a language-preference cookie with a one-year lifetime. Browser local storage also keeps settings such as theme, release server, layout, player and workspace state, and local post drafts. These remain on your device and can be cleared through your browser.

A service worker caches public pages, static files and images for subsequent visits. The service uses cookies for authentication and preferences; third-party sign-in and Cloudflare Turnstile process cookies and device information under their own policies.

The Service does not currently operate third-party advertising, cross-site behavioral advertising, or advertising-profile trackers. Google, GitHub, X, Discord, Cloudflare Turnstile, or other third-party services may use their own cookies or device information when you actively interact with them, under their own policies.
sections.title: Cookies and local device storage

sections.body:
Your approved profile, public UID, posts, comments, attachments, tags, reaction counts, follow information exposed by the feature, creation and last-edit times, generalized IP-region label, and generalized browser or operating-system icon may be visible to other users or the public. Search engines or third parties may copy publicly available information, and we cannot guarantee deletion of copies outside our control.

Authorized moderators or administrators may access pending, blocked, edited, or deleted content; all stored revisions and state events; reports and appeals; the original IP address; full User-Agent; moderation signals and decisions; account restrictions; and other records reasonably necessary to operate, secure, audit, and enforce the Service. Such access is not intended for unrelated personal use.
sections.title: What is public and what administrators can access

sections.body:
We use information to provide and authenticate the Service; deliver requested features; display and organize public content; operate recommendations and notifications; detect spam, fraud, abuse, security incidents, and prohibited conduct; moderate content and decide appeals; enforce the Terms of Use; maintain audit trails; troubleshoot and improve reliability; respond to users and rights holders; and comply with lawful obligations.

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, processing may be necessary to perform our agreement with you, based on your consent, required to comply with law, or based on legitimate interests in operating and protecting a community service. We balance those interests against affected rights. You may withdraw consent where consent is the applicable basis, without affecting earlier lawful processing.
sections.title: Purposes and legal grounds

sections.body:
Posts, comments, profile names, and attachments may be evaluated by automated rules or moderation services and may be placed in pending, allowed, or blocked states. For automated classification, Cloudflare Workers AI may process submitted text, post tags, uploaded images or text files, original file names and, when reviewing a comment, limited excerpts from the related post, parent comment, and recent discussion. Model identifiers, classifications, reasons, and review events may be stored with the moderation record. Editing content triggers a new review for the new revision. Human administrators may review the content, technical records, prior revisions, reports, and appeals and may confirm or change a result. These processes are intended for content safety and do not make decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

The recommended feed uses an internally implemented score based on factors such as recency, engagement, followed authors or tags, muted or blocked preferences, prior feedback, and randomized tie-breaking. Previous exposure lowers weight but does not automatically exclude a post. We do not use third-party advertising profiles for this ranking.
sections.title: Moderation and recommendations

sections.body:
Cloudflare provides network delivery, request metadata, bot verification, application execution, databases, object storage and AI inference for automated moderation. An email service delivers account messages. When you choose third-party sign-in, the selected identity provider handles authentication.

Avatars can use approved uploaded images; when an image is unavailable, the interface displays an initial generated locally. Reference data and media are served through Haneoka and configured resource hosts. When your browser connects to a resource host, that host receives ordinary network information such as the request IP, User-Agent, time and URL, and processes it under its own policies.

We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with valid legal process; protect users, rights holders, the public, or the Service; investigate fraud, security incidents, or abuse; obtain professional advice; or complete a reorganization, transfer, or succession of the project subject to appropriate safeguards. We do not sell personal information, disclose it to data brokers, or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising.
sections.title: Service providers and disclosures

sections.body: The Service and its providers may process or store information in countries or regions other than the one in which you live. Those locations may have different data-protection laws. Where legally required, we rely on an adequacy decision, contractual safeguards, consent, or another permitted transfer mechanism. By using globally delivered network and authentication services, your requests may be routed through infrastructure in multiple jurisdictions.
sections.title: International processing

sections.body:
Account and profile information is kept while an account is active and as needed to provide the service. Account-setup and password-reset links normally last one hour; sessions normally last up to seven days, subject to renewal or revocation. Scheduled jobs clean up expired sessions, verification records and rate-limit records. Email-delivery protection records are retained for security and repeated-request control.

Uploads not attached to a post receive a 24-hour expiry. Rejected or pending-review attachments become eligible for cleanup after 30 days; scheduled jobs perform deletion.

Post and comment revisions, deletion states, moderation cases, appeals, reports, original IP addresses, User-Agent values and related audit events retain their history and may remain throughout service operation, including after content or account deletion. Account deletion disables the public profile and access, and revokes durable sessions. Further handling of identity and historical records follows security, rights-protection, dispute-resolution and applicable legal requirements.
sections.title: Retention, deletion, and account closure

sections.body:
We use measures intended to protect information, including HTTPS in normal production use, salted password hashing, encrypted OAuth tokens, restricted administrative routes, session controls, rate limits, input validation, and audit records. As expressly stated above, original IP addresses and full User-Agents are stored as readable database fields for authorized administration and are not separately encrypted by the application.

No system or transmission is completely secure. You are responsible for protecting your mailbox, password, devices, and active sessions. If we become aware of a qualifying personal-data breach, we will investigate and provide notices to affected persons or authorities when and as required by applicable law.
sections.title: Security and incident handling

sections.body:
Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, portability, or information about processing; withdraw consent; or complain to a competent data-protection authority. These rights may be limited where retention is necessary for freedom of expression, security, fraud prevention, legal obligations, establishment or defense of claims, or protection of others. We may verify identity and request enough information to locate the relevant account before acting.

You can edit profile information, manage social and tag preferences, edit or delete current community content, revoke OAuth access, sign out sessions, and request account deletion through available controls. For a formal request, contact the maintainers using the link below without posting passwords, tokens, raw IP addresses, identity documents, or other sensitive data publicly; ask for a private channel if verification is required.
sections.title: Your rights and choices

sections.body: The Service is not directed to children under 13 or under the minimum age at which they may consent to online data processing in their jurisdiction. We do not knowingly request accounts from children who cannot lawfully consent. A parent or guardian who believes a child provided personal information without valid authorization should contact us so that we can review and take appropriate action. Public archive access remains available without signing in.
sections.title: Children

sections.body: We may revise this Policy to reflect changes in the Service, data practices, providers, law, or security requirements. The effective date above will be updated. Where a change materially expands the use of previously collected information, we will provide a prominent notice or request renewed consent when required before applying the new use. Continued use after a non-material update takes effect is subject to the revised Policy.
sections.title: Changes to this Policy

sections.body: The haneoka project maintainers are the contact point for privacy questions, rights requests, and complaints. Use the project contact link below. Because the linked issue tracker is public, submit only a request for contact and no personal or confidential details; the maintainers may arrange a private verification channel. Nothing in this Policy limits any non-waivable right to contact a competent supervisory or consumer-protection authority.

descriptions.home: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes on haneoka: songs and charts, member and support cards, characters, stories and events. Preview Live2D, Spine and home scenes, read game announcements and join the community.
descriptions.catalog: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes on haneoka: songs and charts, member and support cards, characters, stories and events. Preview Live2D, Spine and home scenes, read game announcements and join the community.
descriptions.catalogItem: Explore detailed information about {title} and its related entries on haneoka, the BanG Dream! Our Notes resource archive for songs, cards, characters, stories and game systems.
descriptions.about: Discover haneoka’s game archive, story and chart players, Live2D and Spine tools, community and public APIs. Learn how Vega, Altair, Deneb and Cassiopeia work together, explore the open-source repositories and follow the project’s technology.
descriptions.community: Discover BanG Dream! Our Notes community posts, discussions and creative contributions. Comment and reply, like or bookmark interesting posts, follow authors and explore related songs, characters and stories.
descriptions.communityTags: Find BanG Dream! Our Notes community topics and creative contributions by tag. Explore related posts and authors, join discussions, and save or share the game content that interests you.
descriptions.communityPlaylists: Discover BanG Dream! Our Notes playlists shared by the community. Browse song covers, bands and track details, listen to music, bookmark favourite playlists and explore related songs and charts.
descriptions.communitySongs: Explore BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! songs with multilingual titles, bands, credits and chart difficulties. View covers and release information, open song details and chart previews, and access Sonolus levels.
descriptions.communityStories: Read BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! event, band, main, area, after-live and card stories. Follow dialogue with character portraits, view complete card artwork and use the available content-language fallback.
descriptions.terms: Read the rules for using haneoka and its community. Learn the requirements for accounts, posts, uploads, reports and moderation, and review resource use, copyright and service terms.
descriptions.privacy: Learn how haneoka handles account details, cookies, community content, uploaded files and visit records. Read about data use, storage, security, user rights, privacy settings and contact options.
descriptions.general: Explore {title} on haneoka, with BanG Dream! Our Notes game information, preview tools and community contributions. Follow related entries to discover songs, characters, cards and stories.
descriptions.announcements: Read BanG Dream! Our Notes announcements, event news, recruitment notices, maintenance updates and known issues. View full articles, images and publication dates in the available language for your selected server.

resources.songs: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes song credits, bands and release information. Compare chart difficulties and note counts, open the chart player or chart image, view rankings and access Sonolus levels.
resources.characters: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes character artwork, profiles and bands. Browse related cards, voices, Live2D models and stories, and follow connections to performances, relationships and game content.
resources.member-cards: Browse BanG Dream! Our Notes member card artwork, attributes, rarity, power and performance skills. Compare level and rank progression, review materials for the current upgrade and explore character stories.
resources.support-cards: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes support card artwork, attributes, rarity, stats and skills. Review level and rank progression, required upgrade materials, related characters and other connected game information.
resources.band-items: Compare BanG Dream! Our Notes band item effects, unlock conditions and level progression. Review coins and materials for the current upgrade and explore related bands, characters and items.
resources.live2d: Browse BanG Dream! Our Notes Live2D models, switch motions and expressions, and adjust parameters and parts. Use pose and screenshot tools, explore characters and costumes, and download model resources.
resources.spine: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes Spine models and animations for characters, scenes and decorations. Adjust the preview, export transparent PNG images and discover related models and game content.
resources.stories: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes band, event, relationship, home and after-live stories. Read dialogue with character portraits and expandable media, or open the story player for scenes, models and performances.
resources.events: Explore BanG Dream! Our Notes event schedules, gameplay, rewards and related stories. Browse linked recruitment, featured cards and songs to understand the event and follow game updates.
